ownerUpdates.text:
Encino Hospital Medical Center Earns Heart Failure Gold Plus Award
Encino Hospital Medical Center has received the American Heart Association’s Get with the Guidelines® – Heart Failure Gold Plus Quality Achievement Award for its commitment to providing high-quality, evidence-based heart failure care.

This recognition highlights the hospital’s dedication to improving patient outcomes and following the latest treatment guidelines for heart failure.

Encino Hospital Medical Center is committed to delivering high-quality care by following the latest evidence-based treatment guidelines, said EM V. Garcia, CEO.

The hospital also earned recognition through the Target: Heart FailureSM Optimal program and the Target: Type 2 Diabetes Honor Roll™ for its commitment to quality patient care.

Encino Hospital Medical Center Earns Top “A” Grades on 2026 Lown Index
Encino Hospital Medical Center, a member of Prime Healthcare Foundation, has earned six “A” grades on the 2026 Lown Hospitals Index for:
Value of Care
Patient Outcomes
Clinical Outcomes
Pay Equity
Avoiding Overuse
Cost Efficiency

These recognitions highlight the hospital’s commitment to high-quality, patient-centered, and cost-effective care.

The Lown Hospitals Index evaluates hospitals nationwide on equity, community impact, and value of care using more than 50 metrics.

This achievement adds to Encino Hospital Medical Center’s continued national recognition for quality, patient safety, and clinical excellence.

Encino Hospital Medical Center Named to Becker’s 100 Great Community Hospitals List
Encino Hospital Medical Center, a member of Prime Healthcare, has been recognized in Becker’s Hospital Review’s 2026 “100 Great Community Hospitals” list, joining other leading hospitals in the Los Angeles area.

“This recognition reflects the heart, compassion, and deep commitment to healing that our physicians, nurses, caregivers, and support teams bring to every patient, every day,” said EM V. Garcia, Chief Executive Officer.

This marks the third consecutive year Encino Hospital has been included on this prestigious list, highlighting its dedication to accessible, high-quality patient care. 

Becker’s Healthcare selects hospitals based on nominations and editorial research, and organizations cannot pay for inclusion.
Encino Hospital was also recently honored with the 2026 PRC Excellence in Healthcare Award, including recognition as a 5-Star Excellence Award recipient in emergency department services for Patient Experience.

April is National Stress Awareness Month
Your mental health is just as important as your physical health. Stress can affect your body in ways you may not notice at first.

Why Stress Matters
Stress-related problems make up over 30% of emergency and mental health visits among adolescents. Ongoing stress keeps the body in “fight or flight” mode, releasing hormones that can raise blood pressure and increase heart risks over time.

Take Control of Your Wellness
Identify what causes your stress
Schedule regular check-ups to catch stress-related health issues early
Seek behavioral health support when needed

Our care teams use screenings like heart rate and blood pressure checks to look for signs of long-term stress.
This Stress Awareness Month, focus on calming your mind to support your heart and overall health.

Encino Hospital Medical Center Receives 5‑Star Excellence Award
Encino Hospital Medical Center has been recognized as a 2026 PRC Excellence in Healthcare 5‑Star Award recipient for Emergency Department Patient Experience.

This award, presented by Professional Research Consultants (PRC), is based on patient survey feedback and highlights our commitment to delivering compassionate, high‑quality care.

PRC President and CEO Joe M. Inguanzo, Ph.D. shared that this recognition reflects dedication to improving patient experiences, employee engagement, and physician alignment.

“We are deeply honored to receive this recognition,” said EM V. Garcia, Chief Executive Officer. “Because this award is based on survey feedback, it reflects the real experiences and voices of our patients, employees, and physicians. I am incredibly proud of our team and the culture of care they embody.”

Encino Hospital Medical Center remains committed to continuously improving the patient experience and ensuring every individual feels cared for, valued, and safe.

Patient Safety Is a Mission, Not a Statistic
During Patient Safety Awareness Week, we thank our dedicated care teams at Encino Hospital Medical Center for their daily commitment to safe, compassionate, and high‑quality care.

Patient safety is built into everything we do from medication accuracy and infection prevention to surgical checklists and systems designed to prevent errors before they reach patients. These practices support better outcomes, open communication, and stronger trust between patients and caregivers.

Transparency is key to building confidence. Hospital Safety Grades from The Leapfrog Group reflect our ongoing focus on safety and accountability. Across Prime Healthcare, many hospitals have earned an “A” Safety Grade, setting a national benchmark for quality care.

This Patient Safety Awareness Week, we encourage patients and families to be active partners in their care and focus on what matters most healing.
